body:
The shared Lua pipeline provides 22 generator profiles, reproducible PDF/SVG exports, CLI workflows, both native TeX adapters, and a browser editor running the same core.

Stages 00-33 passed. Stage 34 current candidate: 8a7f34fa3d84068d6ef98b0c8b3ecf84909abb5f. It includes bounded byte-hash reuse, compensated packing validation, construction-object budget charges, synchronized floral editor seeds, a 27-workload matrix and actual cancellation/resource/editor checks.

The first stage 34 candidate passed all four native jobs plus browser family/editor checks, then failed because the browser performance entrypoint used the wrong downloaded-artifact folder. That run remains rejected and preserved. The corrected entrypoint verifies all 27 recipes under build/performance before browser launch. Actual downloaded-artifact integration and missing-root controls pass. All 90 local timed executable inputs and the browser runner are byte-identical to the tested local sequence; provenance is retained rather than relabelled.

Independent Git verification confirmed all 1,423 file objects, 26 binary assets, modes/history and 297 prior issued evidence hashes. Fresh build 64/run 42325240115 must pass all five jobs and actual artifact reviews before stage 34 acceptance. Stages 35-39 remain pending. Keep this PR draft; no merge, release or deployment has occurred. See docs/project/STATUS.md, STAGES.json and docs/validation/PERFORMANCE-34.md.
